questions: Should the selection of shape-color pairs be random, or should it be the first N pairs from a deterministic ordering (e.g., product order)?
If random selection is used, what is the random seed or source of randomness, and should it be reproducible?
What is the expected behavior when num_pairs is greater than 100? Should it cap at 100, raise an error, or something else?
Should the countplot bars all have a count of 1, or is the countplot intended to show frequencies of pairs from some underlying data?
What should happen if num_pairs is zero or negative? Is there a minimum valid input?
Is the order of pairs in the countplot (along the x-axis) meaningful, and if so, how should they be sorted?
Should the function close or show the plot, or just return the Axes object?
Are the shape and color names case-sensitive, and must they match exactly the strings in SHAPES and COLORS?
